final_assessment: Resumed rc04-readiness-record after rc02c's cycle closed, and the exploration moved mostly by EVENTS rather than by argument. Two of its three open questions resolved themselves: Q-rc04-a (the rc04/rc02c boundary) DISSOLVED rather than being drawn, because rc02c shipped and deleted the predicate the boundary was meant to separate rc04 from — so rc04 owns the record and the judgement outright, and the prerequisite blocking either stage from proposing is gone. Q-rc04-b (does budget stop being a gate input) was raised here, taken by Sal as Q-crc-19, and DELIVERED by rc02c the same day. Q-rc04-c gained evidence rather than an answer: rc02c's scoped iteration-2 external pass wrote a forward recommendation UNPROMPTED into its Notes slot — a ship verdict plus what would undo it — while naming no count, no gate state and no next command, which suggests the D4 commentary prohibition may already permit what exit criterion (1) wants, and that the missing piece is a NAMED SLOT rather than a new practice. Captured three decisions (D-rc04-9, -10, -11), the third of which is the stage's strongest argument: the artifact rc04 replaces now EXISTS and is 3,333 characters of free prose across six residual-risk entries in rc02c's archive emit, in a field whose schema example is 'Archived with 2 incomplete artifacts'. Rewrote the Premise, which still described the retired rc04-cost-visibility deliverables, against the live R-crc-11 charter — and corrected my own error in chat: I had told Sal the charter was partly impossible and needed amending, which came from reading the stale Premise rather than the charter. It does not. One new open question, Q-rc04-d, is the session's real output: is the readiness record WRITTEN at the archive or RENDERED there from a judgement formed earlier? rc02c has a worked instance of the judgement being formed hours before the archive — a scoped external pass bought by choice over a passed gate — and the standing recommendation is derivation over authorship, on the evidence that authorship at the seam is exactly what produced those 3,333 characters. Not ratified; it is a scope call that may be the difference between one capability and two.
